desc:
Train & fight others to become the strongest!

🎮 Play as your favorite characters and more!

📱💻🎮 Play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)

⭐ Please like & favorite the game to support future updates!

🖥️ Controls
G - Ultimate Mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll Cancel
Double Tap W - Run
Left Click - Punch
B - Emote Wheel

🎁 Randomized emote rewards. All items have an equal chance and duplicates are impossible.

⚡ This game is made purely for fun and entertainment.

This game may contain open-source assets and assets from other games. Some characters, maps, and assets belong to their respective creators.
